item.title: Stars Micro System Unveils C82-4G PCIe 6.0 Switch, an 800G AI NIC and a Multi-Mode RAID Chip
item.description: Wuxi-based Stars Micro System launched the C82-4G, which it calls China's first PCIe 6.0 switch, with up to 144 lanes at 64 GT/s, plus an 800G multi-protocol AI NIC and a multi-mode RAID chip.

item.title: DAMO Academy's XuanTie E908A Is an Automotive RISC-V CPU IP Aimed at ASIL-B and ASIL-D Designs
item.description: Alibaba's DAMO Academy says XuanTie E908A is the first RISC-V CPU IP to meet both ASIL-B and ASIL-D, with SPFM above 90%. It also shared an automotive and embodied AI roadmap led by C950A.
